verses.verse:
छिद्रान् सर्वान् समाच्छाद्य फूत्कारस्तु शनैः शनैः।
क्रीयते तेन यो नादो जायते प्रथमो हि सः।८२।
verses.text: With all the holes covered, the blowing is done very gently; the sound that arises from it is indeed the first.

commentary.text: With all the holes in the flute, however many there are, properly closed, the nāda (sound) that comes from blowing very gently — take that as the first note of the flute. Keep in mind that if the holes are not completely closed, the note may change and become the eighth note.

subsection.title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
